newline: lf, bom: no
preamble:
  shebang: #!/usr/bin/env dotnet
  directive: package Reverb.Runtime 0.1.0
  header: v1
cells:
  [0] setup
      | using Reverb;
  [1] code id=risky
      | static int ParseOrThrow(string s) =>
      |     int.TryParse(s, out var v) ? v : throw new BadInputException(s);
  [2] code id=attempt
      | string message;
      | try
      | {
      |     ParseOrThrow("nope");
      |     message = "parsed";
      | }
      | catch (BadInputException e)
      | {
      |     message = $"bad input: {e.Input}";
      | }
  [3] code id=show
      | Console.WriteLine(message);
  [4] types
      | class BadInputException(string input) : Exception($"Can't parse '{input}'")
      | {
      |     public string Input { get; } = input;
      | }
diagnostics: none
